question: Fit a Gaussian Mixture Model with 3 components (random_state=42) to the dataset. Visualize the clusters with scatter plots and overlay ellipses representing the Gaussian components. Report the mixing weights, means, and covariances for each component.

expected_output.description: feature_1 as x-axis, feature_2 as y-axis, points colored by cluster with covariance ellipses overlaid
rows as GMM components, columns should include Component, Weight, Mean_0, Mean_1, Cov_0_0, Cov_0_1, Cov_1_0, Cov_1_1
